tools.name: preflight_x402_payment
tools.description: FREE. Run this before paying any x402 (HTTP 402) service. Pass the service URL and the PAYMENT-REQUIRED value it sent you (or price_usd and pay_to). Returns GO / CAUTION / STOP with reasons: is the service working, is the price fair (vs its public listing, what our monitor saw, and similar services)

tools.name: check_x402_service
tools.description: FREE. Before paying an x402 (HTTP 402) API, check it: is it up right now, does its real price match its listing, and is there a cheaper service that does the same job? Covers ~25,000 paid agent APIs, re-checked continuously.

tools.name: find_cheapest_x402_service
tools.description: Describe what you need; get the cheapest WORKING paid APIs for it, ranked by live price, uptime and speed, with example inputs. 20 free calls per day per client, then $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

tools.name: read_web_page
tools.description: Fetch a public web page or PDF and return clean Markdown of the main content, plus title, author, date, JSON-LD and links. $0.003 per call via x402. Failed reads are not charged.

tools.name: get_page_metadata
tools.description: Title, description, canonical URL, language, site name, author, publish date, image and JSON-LD of a public page. $0.002 per call via x402.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_web_page, get_page_metadata · Private data: preflight_x402_payment · Public sink: get_page_metadata · Destructive: preflight_x402_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_web_page, get_page_metadata · Private data: preflight_x402_payment · Public sink: get_page_metadata · Destructive: preflight_x402_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
